name: ralph-loop
title: Ralph Loop
description: Implement one slice at a time with TDD, focused checks, and explicit pause points.
command_description: Run the AFK implementation loop for one slice using failing-test-first discipline.
prompt: Pull one slice from docs/ai/backlog.md, explore the codebase, write or identify the failing test first, implement the minimum change to pass, rerun focused checks, and update docs/ai/handoff.md with current state, validation, and next step. Do not broaden scope beyond the current slice.
